analyst.summary: Ellenbarrie is a well-run, capacity-expanding industrial-gases supplier with a clean balance sheet, but FY26 revenue growth slowed to 9.3% (from a historical ~18-19% pace), nearly half of FY26 pretax profit came from non-operating treasury income rather than the core gas business, and the stock -- even after a roughly 52% fall from its post-listing high -- still trades at about 40x earnings versus a sector average nearer 23x. The valuation continues to assume a growth rate the recent results have not delivered. We rate it a Sell within the existing NDPMS review, consistent with the quantitative screen.
